title: [GMCP 203.038.02] Production path: Catalog, discovery, health, compatibility, and trust intelligence
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-038-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: Local configs, running processes, package managers, the official registry and explicit endpoints reconcile into one deduplicated catalog with provenance. Active probes measure protocol/extension compatibility, health, latency and policy fitness without granting trust; recommendations explain evidence and cost; stale or conflicting records converge; and discovery never installs, enables or sends data without authorization. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
